body:
Kevin bowed his head to give thanks for his meal. Taking notice, his coworker Jerry began asking questions about Kevin’s faith in Christ. After work, they continued to talk, and Kevin introduced Jerry to Christ. Jerry excitedly invited Kevin for dinner so Kevin could share Jesus with rest of Jerry’s family.

The following night the Lord stood near Paul and said, “Take courage! As you have testified about me in Jerusalem, so you must also testify in Rome” (Acts 23:11).

Paul was called and used of God to testify to the multitudes, high-ranking Roman officials, and Jewish leaders about the resurrection of Jesus Christ. Paul’s reputation for standing up, standing out, and standing firm on the power in the resurrection of Christ brought glory to God and souls into the Kingdom.

When was the last time you shared your faith with your family, friends, or coworkers? Just as God called Paul to testify, He is calling you to share, care, and make people aware of what God has done in you.

Challenge for Today:

Share your faith or testimony with someone today.
